title: [29.x]-Bug 658800: [Expense Agent] Expense User Card rejects manual approval setup with duplicate error
summary: Fixed Expense Agent's approval setup page to allow users to manually configure multiple approval routes without rejecting duplicate configuration attempts.
key_points: Corrected validation logic in Expense Approval Setups page that prevented legitimate duplicate entries
Users can now set up multiple approval routes for the Expense Agent
Added test coverage for the duplicate approval setup scenario
Bug occurred when users attempted manual approval configuration
